conditions.label: Evidence and transaction state
conditions.required_treatment: Name the order/invoice/acceptance/settlement stage and actual evidence. Forecast cash dates remain assumptions until actual receipts/payments are supported.

conditions.label: Object and settlement reconciliation
conditions.required_treatment: Reconcile real deposit, final bill, unpaid balance, fees, net cash, refund and credit by object and transaction identity. Row-ID uniqueness alone is insufficient.

conditions.label: Matched decision date and unavoidable costs
conditions.required_treatment: Show the same decision/horizon and baseline in A/B. Preserve incurred or unavoidable cost/cash when future event activity is deselected; isolate genuinely avoidable future work.

conditions.label: Within-horizon expiry and remaining work
conditions.required_treatment: Add due/use/expiry reminders and link continuing benefits to actual delivery dates, skill and capacity. Opening-date status alone misses upcoming expiry.

conditions.label: Gross/net, noncash and applicable tax basis
conditions.required_treatment: Separate noncash support and displaced work from money; reconcile settlement fees and applicable taxes without automatically assigning a VAT rate or recovery.

conditions.label: Term, bundle, right and payer
conditions.required_treatment: Specify contract term, asset/use/user rights, included benefits, responsible payer and country. Do not duplicate bundled sales or assume renewal.

conditions.label: Receipt and delivery stress together
conditions.required_treatment: Stress delayed/no renewal and jointly dependent receipts against supplier dates and continuing fulfilment work. Do not assign a probability from aggregate survey or comparator data.

conditions.label: Proportionate implementation and current commission
conditions.required_treatment: Use linked existing schedules, not a new research system or questionnaire. Keep the USD1500 commission, reported USD750 upfront and conditional USD750 balance distinct from future sponsor receipts; no scope, fee or participation change.

presentation_or_integration_limits_ident: Distinct IDs do not detect duplicated real transaction
Opening-date credit status does not flag all within-horizon expiries
Counterfactual route filter needs a matched incurred/unavoidable baseline
